text:
Type: small floral wool area rug
Use: under a chair or desk, softening floors; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: wool, carved textured pile
Colors: warm taupe, beige, dark brown
Shape: rectangular, dense all-over tonal floral scroll pattern, plain beige border band, thin profile, compact
Feel: subtle, warm, refined, quiet
Goes with: dark wood floors and furniture, linen upholstery, woven baskets; traditional or transitional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Floral Wool Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Taupe
product.description: The old-world style of floral design gets a modern update in this taupe rug, which is ready to create a soothing atmosphere in a living or dining room. The high-low pile combination creates warm and inviting textures and patterns. 4' x 6' High/low pile is easy to clean. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
